explanation: Differentiate F(C) with respect to C: F'(C)=9/5, since the derivative of 32 is zero. Thus the instantaneous rate is 9/5 degrees Fahrenheit per degree Celsius.

answers.correct_value: $\frac{9}{5}$ degrees of Fahrenheit per degree of Celsius
